Zoe (People Ops): Quick Q — after the product/org merge we have 3 manager requests for mid-cycle salary increases. What’s the canonical ops flow for these so we don’t miss payroll cutoffs?
Carla (People Ops): Short answer: submit the comp-change PR in Workbench + manager sign-off in the form. Payroll cutoff is always the 15th for the next-month pay cycle.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Thanks. Do we need Director approval for >10% increases?
Carla (People Ops): Yes — anything >=10% or that moves someone across market band requires Director + People Ops approval. Also notify finance for budget carve-out.
Leo (SWE): One of the requests is for a lateral regrade (level move without title change). Any difference in docs?
Carla (People Ops): For regrades: include the leveling justification doc, the manager evidence summary, and the target comp table. Use template: https://redwood.workbench/leveling-template
Maria (Recruiter): Heads up — if comp increases risk offer bands for open roles, flag us early. We can coordinate backfills and posting ranges.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Who actually submits the Workbench PR? Me as manager or someone in People Ops?
Carla (People Ops): Manager submits the initial PR with case details, then People Ops verifies and moves to approvals queue. We can submit on your behalf if you’re under deadline — ping `@Carla` with the packet.
comp-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff is 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC for changes to appear in 2026-04 payroll. Late submissions are processed for the following month.
Zoe (People Ops): Important: include the effective date in the PR. If you want it to apply in April payroll set effective date <= 2026-03-15.
Ravi (Eng Manager): Got it. One request includes a retro pay period — how is backpay handled?
Carla (People Ops): Retro pay is allowed up to 60 days with justification. Put the retro window and compute in the PR; finance will confirm exact payment timing.
Leo (SWE): Any changes to equity or refreshes handled here or separate?
Carla (People Ops): Equity/bump requests go through the equity committee — include the comp PR and we’ll route. Different approvers and timelines.
Maria (Recruiter): Also remind managers to cc the hiring partner on requests that affect open reqs so we don’t surprise candidates.
Ravi (Eng Manager): If we have 3 folks across two teams, can we batch a single PR?
Carla (People Ops): You can batch multiple changes in one PR if they share the same cost center and effective date. Otherwise separate PRs.
Zoe (People Ops): Quick checklist for managers I’ll paste to the template channel:
- Manager submits Workbench PR
- Attach leveling justification / evidence
- Add compensation table + retro calc if needed
- Director approval for >=10% or band cross
- People Ops verifies -> Finance -> Payroll cutoff
Ravi (Eng Manager): Perfect. If we run into tight deadlines I’ll DM `@Carla` to help submit. :thumbsup:
Carla (People Ops): Great — I’ll post the short checklist and the form link in #people-ops-templates. If anyone wants me to pre-check packets, drop them into my queue.
Zoe (People Ops): Thanks all — closing the loop. If anything unexpected pops up, react here or DM. :white_check_mark:
